flags.message: Although context.json sets mode='forward', this is a historical November 2016 application (cutoff 2016-11-04). While running pre-cutoff CourtListener searches (filed_before='2016-11-03') for the lower-court decision in Arthur v. State (Ala. Crim. App. CR-15-1452, 236 So. 3d 155, decided Oct. 19, 2016), the cluster metadata included a Westlaw subsequent-history string noting 'Certiorari Denied by Arthur v. Alabama, U.S., April 17, 2017' (referring to linked cert petition 16-595, not application 16A450), and a SCOTUS search scoped to filed_before='2016-11-03' returned the November 3, 2016 stay orders in companion application 16A451/16-602 (Arthur v. Dunn, 137 S. Ct. 14 and 15). No disposition for 16A450 surfaced, and only pre-cutoff facts were used in the forecast.
